designationHistory.indexText: D'Arbonne National Wildlife Refuge in north Louisiana was established in 1975, after most of its land was bought, under an interim management permit with the Department of the Army.

authority.citation: Land acquisition; interim management permit with the Department of the Army

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, D'Arbonne NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2006 (ServCat 168191)
